title: Running sum: one variable carries the work forward

steps.caption: Start with total = 0 and an empty output list.
total += 3 → 3. It already contains everything before index 0, so no re-adding.
total += 1 → 4. It already contains everything before index 1, so no re-adding.
total += 4 → 8. It already contains everything before index 2, so no re-adding.
total += 1 → 9. It already contains everything before index 3, so no re-adding.
total += 5 → 14. It already contains everything before index 4, so no re-adding.
Done in one pass: O(n). This output is the prefix-sum array.
